classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. The multiples-of-17 example gives the corresponding condition x/2 ∈ ℤ for even integers.

content.prompt:
Write the following description of a set in set notation.

Even integers between $-3$ and $7$.

answer.worked:
The even integers strictly between $-3$ and $7$ are $-2,0,2,4,6$.

$$\left\{x\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }-3<x<7\text{ and }\frac{x}{2}\in\mathbb Z\right\}=\{-2,0,2,4,6\}.$$
